r9_ccp_stoker.name: Brann
pages:
The vent keeps my forge warm.
You keep me busy. Fair trade?
battle_won:
Too much heat for your team.
Cool off and come back.
after:
Drop off the ledge.
Mind the ash on the way down.

pages:
A kettle sits on a hot rock.
It's been boiling for years.

Nobody knows who left it.
Nobody's brave enough to ask.

r9_cvp_watcher.name: Runa
r9_cvp_watcher._name_note: Renamed from Ilse: Ilse is already the Switchbacks warden.
pages:
From up here I see the whole town.
And now I see you.
battle_lost:
You climbed through ash for that?
Respect.
battle_won:
The ash got in your eyes.
Try again when it settles.
after:
The ledge drops you right
into town.

pages: A soot-black bell in the wall.

Ring it and the whole town
looks up. Better not.

r9_lgp_lampwright.name: Oona
pages:
Every lamp in the harbor was lit
from this loft. Want to see?
battle_won:
Lights out for your team.
Rest up and come back.
after:
Hop down the ledge
to the pools.

pages:
A jar of spare wicks,
all labeled by year.
One label just says: OOPS.

r9_lpp_signaller.name: Marit
pages:
I flash the boats home from here.
You came the long way.
battle_won:
Message lost at sea.
Come back when you're ready.
after: Drop off the ledge into town.

pages:
A cracked signal mirror.
It still flashes: HI.
It only knows one word.

r9_rasp_saltpan.name: Dagny
pages:
I rake salt up here where the
wind can't steal it. Battle?
battle_won:
Salt in the wound, sorry.
Rest your team and come back.
after:
The ledge drops you back
on the trail.

pages: A salt castle with tiny salt flags.
A sign on it says: DO NOT LICK.

r9_rasp_gullkeeper.name: Tarn
r9_rasp_gullkeeper._name_note: Renamed from Pell: Pell is the Cairnfold digger.
pages:
The gulls nest in this notch.
They let me stay. Will you?
battle_lost: The gulls like you. So do I.
battle_won:
The gulls are laughing.
Don't take it personally.
after:
Ledge down, and mind
the feathers.

pages: A nest of odd feathers.

One is blue, one is gold,
and one is a pencil.

r9_rasp_tidecaller.name: Ottilie
pages:
From up here I call the tides in.
You just walked in.
battle_won:
The tide went out on you.
It always comes back.
after: Drop down to the north field.

pages:
A huge spiral shell.
Hold it to your ear.

It hums the Saltmere song,
off-key.
